learning_outcomes.text: Adequate knowledge of the concept of business, its institutional and legal framework, organization and management.
Oral and written communication in native language.
Draft a report on the analysis of a specific company and orally present its relevant aspects.
Search and analyze information from various sources related to the business world applied to specific business situations.
Value the meaning and importance of business administration as a way to coordinate efforts to maintain and improve its competitiveness.
Explain how different environmental factors affect business activity.
Describe the characteristics of business governance according to its legal form.
Describe planning, organization, human resource management, and control as functions of the administration process and value their contribution to business administration and management.
Define the variables for human resource management in an organization.
Apply basic knowledge for business organizational design.
Analyze the systemic nature of the company and explain the main dimensions of the functional subsystems: production, financial, investment, commercial, human resources, and management.

syllabus_topics: The figure of the entrepreneur and the manager
The business plan and the Lean Canvas model
Concept of environment: general and specific environment
Ethical and social responsibilities of management
The economy of the common good and the common good balance sheet
The Human System of the Company
Planning in the company: concept and elements
The organizing function: Formal and informal organization
Types of control in the company
assessment_rules: To pass, students must achieve an overall average of at least 5 out of 10, with a minimum of 5 out of 10 in both continuous assessment (30%) and the final exam (70%). If the minimum score is not met in any part, the global average cannot exceed 4.5. For the second call, the continuous assessment grade is carried over if passed, otherwise it is assessed via a practical exam. Fraudulent activity results in a 0 for the affected activity or exam.
